props.name: title
props.description: Headline. Rendered as an accessibility header (text/mobile/title-sm).

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy. Rendered in color/text/warning per the warning tone.

props.name: steps
props.description: Optional ordered 'what to do next' steps. Presence shows a divider + numbered list (replaces the Figma helpTips boolean).

props.name: illustration
props.description: Visual above the text (slot). undefined → built-in themed warning badge; null → hidden; otherwise the caller's node.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: Filled primary button (e.g. Go Back & Review). Supports a loading spinner.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Outline secondary button (e.g. Continue). Rendered ABOVE the primary action (consistent with ErrorState).

states.transitions: primaryAction.loading / secondaryAction.loading toggle the per-button spinner. Caller-driven; no internal async state.

loading.placement: on the primary/secondary action button (Button loading state)
loading.error: Caller toggles action.loading; WarningState runs no async.

edgeCases.nullData: description, steps, illustration and both actions are optional; omitted parts are not rendered. steps: undefined/empty → no list.

a11y.element: View group; title is accessibilityRole=header; actions are role=button via the Button primitive
keyboard: Touch only; VoiceOver/TalkBack read the header, message, steps, then the buttons in order
a11y.focusManagement: none — the host BottomSheet owns modal focus
a11y.srAnnouncements: Container is a polite live region, so the warning is announced when it appears.

tests: renders steps + default title when provided
primary does not fire while loading

ops.security: title/description/steps are app-supplied strings rendered via <Text> (RN escapes content; no markup injection).
